summary: End-to-end testing of the new Do Not Email (DNE / Suppression List) feature. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering CRUD, auto-create Global list, normalize/dedupe/invalid handling, CSV/XLSX/single-col CSV/multi-col-no-header (400)/oversize (400) uploads, search, remove/delete with cascading unlink from campaigns + drips, Global cannot be deleted (400), auth (401), cross-user 404, /api/unsubscribe/{user_id}/{email} mirroring into Global DNE, /api/suppression mirroring into Global DNE, real-time suppression in standard campaign queue (suppressed status flipped, error_message set, suppressed_count incremented & exposed via GET), drip campaign suppression_list_ids CRUD + 'suppressed' stat key, real-time re-check (no caching), no _id leak. Drip Campaigns regression suite (23/23) still green. Frontend: sidebar nav-do-not-email link, /do-not-email auto-creates + pins Global list with 'GLOBAL' badge, create dialog navigates to detail, manual add dialog adds emails (mixed comma/newline), search filters live, remove deletes row + decrements count, CSV upload parses & adds emails, delete non-global list removes card, Drip detail Settings tab shows multi-select drip-dne-{list_id}.

minor.issue: Spec says POST but implementation is GET (link-click pattern). Treated as GET in tests; fine.

integration_issues.issue: Could not confirm dne-checkbox-{list_id} renders on /campaign during automated run (page didn't expose 'Do Not Email' header text). Code path exists in Campaign.jsx (lines 696-738) but waiting/loading order may need a ProtectedRoute warm-up. Recommend manual quick check.

Could not visually confirm 'Suppressed' StatBlock at top of detail page during automated run; code path exists at DripCampaignView.jsx:383. Likely rendered fine, but the bare-text grep missed it. Recommend manual visual verification.

issues: React hydration warning: an emergent VisualEditor <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper is placed between <tbody> and <tr>, causing 'span cannot be a child of tbody' warning. Cosmetic / VE-only, not a functional bug.

POST /api/dne-lists creates non-global list; empty name -> 400
GET /api/dne-lists/{id} returns paginated emails + total_filtered + skip/limit
POST .../emails normalises (lowercase/trim), dedupes, marks invalid; idempotent re-add reports skipped_duplicates
Search query param filters server-side
DELETE single email decrements email_count
POST .../upload accepts CSV with 'email' header, single-column CSV, and XLSX
Multi-column CSV without 'email' header -> 400; >2MB upload -> 400
DELETE Global list -> 400
DELETE non-global list -> 200, unlinks list_id from campaigns + drip_campaigns suppression_list_ids
Cross-user GET on another user's list -> 404
GET /api/unsubscribe/{user_id}/{email} mirrors email into Global DNE list
POST /api/suppression mirrors email into Global DNE list
POST /api/campaigns accepts suppression_list_ids; PUT updates; GET returns
POST /api/drip-campaigns accepts suppression_list_ids; PUT updates; GET returns; stats.suppressed key present
Real-time standard-campaign suppression: suppressed queue item, error_message set, NOT 'sent', campaigns.suppressed_count incremented, exposed via GET (simulated SMTP account)
is_email_suppressed lookup is per-send (no cache) — recheck campaign with mid-suppressed email correctly flips to 'suppressed'
ObjectId _id NEVER present in any DNE / campaign / drip response (recursive check)
Drip campaigns full regression suite still passes (23/23)
Frontend: nav-do-not-email exists in sidebar and routes to /do-not-email
Frontend: Global list auto-created and pinned first with 'GLOBAL' badge; cannot be deleted (no trash icon on Global card)
Frontend: create dialog (dne-create-btn -> dne-name-input -> dne-create-confirm-btn) navigates to /do-not-email/{list_id}
Frontend: dne-add-manual-btn + dne-bulk-textarea + dne-add-confirm-btn adds 3 newline/comma-separated emails
Frontend: dne-search-input filters rows live (1 match for 'ui_test_a')
Frontend: dne-remove-{email} removes a row and decrements list
Frontend: dne-file-input + CSV upload adds parsed emails
Frontend: dne-delete-{list_id} + dne-delete-confirm-btn removes the list card
Frontend: Drip detail Settings tab renders drip-dne-{list_id} multi-select
action_items: Optional: confirm /campaign page renders 'Do Not Email Lists' section and dne-checkbox-{list_id} on first load (automated grep missed it; might be loading-state ordering).
Optional: confirm 'Suppressed' StatBlock on Drip detail header is visually visible (code present, just not asserted by text grep).

Cosmetic: emergent VisualEditor span wrapper inside <tbody> causes a React hydration warning on DoNotEmailDetail page — VE-only, can be ignored or worked around by moving the row mapping outside <tbody>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at 5858 lines — splitting routers (dne, campaigns, drips, suppression) into separate modules would aid maintainability.
/api/unsubscribe/{user_id}/{email} is a GET (intentional for one-click unsubscribe links). The spec line says POST — keep GET (matches RFC 8058 + email-link UX), and update the spec/docs accordingly.
DNE upload doesn't set a max-row hard limit beyond the 2MB byte cap; a malicious 2MB single-column CSV could insert ~100k emails — consider an explicit row cap.

is_email_suppressed scans suppression_list and dne_emails on every send — fine at current scale, but add a compound index hint or per-recipient memoization within a single queue worker run if list sizes grow large.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of asserted DNE flows; Campaign-page DNE checkbox + Drip 'Suppressed' stat block need visual reconfirmation
